name: Original Thrum
description: Strike with the oldest thrum of the body from which every later blow descends.

name: Foundational Chord
description: Hold the chord on which all other chords rest so that blows break against the base of the world.

name: Oldest Echo
description: Hear the oldest echo that still lingers in a place and tell what first sounded there.

name: Quickening Note
description: Sound the note that quickens living flesh so that grave wounds on an ally or the self close in a long calm breath.

name: Heavenly Drone
description: Hold a drone as wide as the sky that presses every foe in the field to the ground.

name: Echoing World
description: Let the world itself echo every blow aimed at the user back at the one who threw it.

name: Splitting Overtone
description: Raise an overtone above the range of any guard and let it split armor and wards.

name: Revival Hymn
description: Sing a hymn over an ally whose breath and pulse have just stopped and call the heart back within the short window.

name: First Frequency
description: Ring the first frequency of the canon so that the whole field shakes at its ground tone.

name: Harmonic Dominion
description: Rule the field by its harmonics so that foes are pressed down and the user and allies are lifted on the same tone.

name: Unbound Resonance
description: Loose the resonance of the canon with no bound until it fills the field and rings the stone.

name: Ruin Chorus
description: Raise a chorus of ruin from every echo of the field at the full destructive ceiling of its tier.

name: First Sound
description: Sound the first sound and for an instant return the field to the state before any sound existed so that nothing within it can vibrate; no cultivation energy mechanic explains this silence and its use is a consequence event.
